extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians and authors considering submission to Selecta Mathematica
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a research article to the peer-reviewed journal Selecta Mathematica (New Series), aimed at a wide mathematical audience; papers should meet the journal's scope and quality expectations. Emphasis is on well-written, high-quality work in pure mathematics (and selected applied areas), especially those that can open new perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience — addressed to a wide mathematical audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Selecta Mathematica, New Series is a peer-reviewed journal addressed to a wide mathematical audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should be written and presented so that they are accessible and of interest to a broad readership across mathematics, not only to a narrow specialist subcommunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope — subject areas accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: It accepts well-written high quality papers in all areas of pure mathematics, and selected areas of applied mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should ensure their manuscript falls within pure mathematics or in an applied area that the journal considers relevant; out-of-scope applied work may be unsuitable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of writing and exposition
rubrics_metrics.description: It accepts well-written high quality papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should have clear exposition, rigorous arguments, and high editorial quality (clarity of presentation, organization, and correctness). Poorly written or expository-weak submissions are unlikely to be acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / potential impact — opening new perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal especially encourages submission of papers which have the potential of opening new perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that introduces new viewpoints, methods, or directions and that can influence future research is particularly welcome; incremental results with limited broader significance are less favored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Selecta Mathematica, New Series is a peer-reviewed journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions will be evaluated through peer review; authors should expect standard scholarly review for correctness, novelty, significance, and exposition.
